description: This is a configuration file for Cypress, a JavaScript-based end-to-end testing framework. It defines test setup, including custom commands for database management via Axios, and hooks into Cypress events for test lifecycle management.

methods.name: asyncWrapper
methods.description: Wraps a promise to catch errors and return a tuple of [result, error].

methods.name: createSavePoint
methods.description: Creates a database savepoint via an HTTP POST request to the testing API.

methods.name: restoreToSavePoint
methods.description: Restores the database to a specified savepoint via an HTTP POST request.

methods.name: deleteSavePoints
methods.description: Deletes specified savepoints through an API call.

methods.name: resetDatabase
methods.description: Resets the database to a clean state via an API call.

methods.name: truncateTable
methods.description: Truncates specified tables in the database via an API call.
